verdict.rationale: A live probe found a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) on HMRC's developer hub with explicit rules: "Disallow: /" for all user agents and an Allow only for Googlebot. An agent can therefore learn what it may read before fetching anything, though the answer is essentially "nothing" for non-Google agents. missing for 10: robots.txt evidence for the main gov.uk guidance pages and the API host, independent corroboration beyond a single probe, and rules that grant agents any readable scope on the developer hub.
